name: bountyradar-mcp
title: BountyRadar MCP
description: Remote MCP server that aggregates AI-agent-solvable bounties across Opire, BountyHub, ClawHunt, Algora, GitHub and validated security programs, then scores each for agent-solvability, freshness and competition and serves a ranked, agent-consumable feed. Tools: get_bounty_feed, search_bounties, get_bounty_detail, score_bounty, list_sources, get_stats, subscribe_feed. Pay-per-event; initialize and tools/list are free.

inputSchema.title: BountyRadar MCP
inputSchema.description: This Actor is a remote MCP server and takes no manual input. Connect your MCP client to the Actor's standby /mcp endpoint (see README) and call the tools from there. Tool calls are metered pay-per-event; initialize and tools/list are free.
